findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: api_key_create · Private data: industry_clusters_list, location_groups_list, api_key_create, stories_retrieve, stories_industry_location_list, stories_organization_list · Public sink: api_key_create, stories_retrieve, stories_industry_location_list, stories_organization_list.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: api_key_create · Private data: industry_clusters_list, location_groups_list, api_key_create, stories_retrieve, stories_industry_location_list, stories_organization_list · Public sink: api_key_create, stories_retrieve, stories_industry_location_list, stories_organization_list

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "location_groups_list" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
